catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class observes a nav_msgs/Odometry topic. cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 control a world but do not subscribe to odometry, and cap.motion.* classes are commands with reached or measured motion outputs. This package uses an extension read with an inline output schema for the pose and twist fields the odometry plugin publishes.

No catalogue class observes a sensor_msgs/Imu topic. The sensor classes are device resource kinds, not a ROS subscription with the IMU orientation, angular velocity and linear acceleration fields. This package uses an extension read with an inline output schema.
